title: Lavender Georgette Anarkali Suit Set with Zardozi Handwork & Gota Lace Dupatta
color_custom: Lavender with gold zardozi handwork & gota lace
description:
Ruhani means "of the soul" – a soft lavender that feels like a quiet celebration, finished by hand in pure zardozi.

Made for the twirl. This lavender georgette Anarkali opens into a full, floor-sweeping flare finished with layered rows of gold gota lace. The V-neckline and the sleeve cuffs are worked by hand in pure zardozi – floral motifs in antique-gold thread, sequins and beads – with a matching hand-embroidered motif at the centre of the yoke. Scattered buttis add a soft sparkle. The georgette dupatta is edged in gota lace for a complete, graceful look.

✦ The Details
• V-neckline with pure zardozi hand embroidery
• Hand-embroidered zardozi motif at the centre of the yoke
• Sheer full sleeves with zardozi-embroidered cuffs
• Fitted bodice with a full, flowy Anarkali flare
• Layered gota lace on the hem
• Matching cotton pants and georgette dupatta with gota lace border and buttis

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft georgette with a breathable cotton lining – light, flowy and comfortable through long celebrations. The yoke and sleeves are pure hand zardozi work, done stitch by stitch by our karigars in Jaipur, so every piece is slightly unique.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Pearl chandbalis, a small bindi and soft curls for a sangeet or mehendi; nude block heels and a gold potli for a wedding reception. Keep the neck bare so the zardozi neckline can shine.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.

care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth with tissue over the zardozi and gota. Steam or iron on low heat on the reverse side.
